text:
Maya (Product): quick micro-check for Q2 OKR milestones — please drop: shipped | slipped | next action (+ owner). Need a single deck slide by Fri EOD. TL;DR: runtime-v2 canary, dedicated GPU pools, quantization evals, perf regressions.

Devon (Eng-Platform): runtime-v2 canary: shipped ✅ — canary live in us-west and eu-central. Next: scale test to 10k rps by Wed (owner: @devon). Saw intermittent batching flake on long sequences, tracking in #eng-runtime. :eyes:

Arjun (Eng-ML): quant evals: partially shipped — 3/5 eval suites passed on 8-bit config, slipped on safety/regression suite. Next: narrow prompt set + A/B with previous quant profile (owner: @arjun). ETA end of week for patch.

Priya (Eng-Infra): dedicated GPU pool infra: slipped due to unexpected Nvidia driver regression on 2.x kernels. Root cause identified (driver <-> kernel mismatch). Next: staging rollback + vendor patch, tentative ship Thu AM (owner: @priya). Impact: Dedicated customers on new pools delayed ~3 days.

Sam (Eng-SRE): reliability note — canary exposed a memory leak in KV cache after ~12h under mixed load. We mitigated via autoscaler scale-up and restarted nodes. Next action: leak repro + hotfix PR (owner: @sam). If hotfix delayed, set autoscaler floor to +20% as temporary protection.

Lena (Product): thanks — for exec slide can we have one bullet each: shipped (metrics), slipped (reason + ETA), owner + next step. I'll compile. Small ask: include token-cost delta if known.

Devon (Eng-Platform): adding quick numbers for runtime-v2 canary: p50 latency -2ms, p95 -10ms, token cost -6% on average. Will paste into the slide.

Arjun (Eng-ML): quant delta: quality regression on safety suite +2.1% false positives; cost improvement ~-18% tokens. Putting short note in thread.

Priya (Eng-Infra): infra ETA update: vendor confirmed driver build, smoke testing Thu AM, roll Thu PM. Will update when smoke passes.

Sam (Eng-SRE): hotfix plan: repro, patch in feature branch, canary deploy, monitor 24h. Owner @sam, T-shirt ETA 48h.

Maya (Product): perfect. I'll assemble; if anything slips further pls ping me directly. Also, can owners add one-line ask for design or QA help if needed.

Devon (Eng-Platform): FYI @lena we need one QA resource for scale tests Wed. @qa-team can we assign 1 person? :pray:

Lena (Product): noted, I'll ping QA and loop back by EOD.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: runtime-v2-canary @us-west (build 2026.03.15-089). Logs: `deploy: started` `nodes: 12 -> 14` `status: rolling`.

Arjun (Eng-ML): minor note — I'll follow up with eval artifacts (CSV + sample diffs) in the shared drive.

Maya (Product): final ask — owners, please add your one-line update to this thread (exact shipped/slipped/next) so I can copy verbatim into the slide. Thanks! :sparkles:
